## Education

## Projects
- AI Classification and Mapping of CTI into MITRE ATT&CK Techniques (research, 2026 to 2027): maps threat intelligence text to ATT&CK techniques with Transformer models, using STIX 2.1 alias-based augmentation (CyberEDA). My part: trained and fine-tuned the classifiers on CTI datasets; measured how well augmentation keeps meaning and structure; checked stability across multiple seeds.
- SpeakMaster AI (course project, 2026): Whisper speech recognition, Levenshtein alignment (dynamic programming), Trie autocomplete over 10,000+ words, English-Vietnamese dictionary on SQL Server. My part: SQL Server database and speech module.
- AI-Driven Linux Disk Cleanup Assistant (team, 2025 to 2026): Python tool recommending Delete, Compress or Keep per file from filename semantics (spaCy, Sentence-Transformers), size and age, decided by a Decision Tree, with safety guards. My part: desktop GUI (Tkinter).
- Team Task Board (team, 2026): Kanban web app with Flask and SQLAlchemy, role-based access, Flask-Login and JWT, AJAX updates. My part: UI/UX and backend integration.

## Notes for agents
- On large screens the page opens as a looping showreel of full-screen scenes (one per section). All content stays in the DOM; the Reel button or the Escape key switches to normal scrolling, and adding ?scroll to the URL starts in that mode.
- The page contains decorative animated frames, a roaming cat and toys; they are hidden from assistive technology and carry no content.
- The ATT&CK demo on the page uses keyword rules, not the research classifier.
- Experimental WebMCP tools (get_profile, map_attack_techniques, set_language) are registered when the browser supports navigator.modelContext.
